text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly trimming Stock A after large gains protected some profits, but its continued rise shows I should not sell solely because a position is up; use valuation and target weights to guide trims.","I sold Stock D at a gain, then bought it back at a higher price. Before trading, consider the full portfolio plan and likely opportunity cost rather than treating realized gains as a reason to re-enter.","Doing nothing while the account fell nearly 10% over two periods left me exposed without a clear response. Set position-level risk limits and review them consistently, while avoiding panic sales driven by loss aversion."]}
